we developed a single-tube flow cytometry assay for the determination of the immune status of peripheral whole blood.
a novel, easy to establish, fast, precise and robust flow cytometry assay for a comprehensive analysis of immune status and immune dynamics in peripheral whole blood was developed.
the here presented single-tub multicolor flow cytometer assay is easy to establish, fast and precise to analyze the immune status from patient's whole blood.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a fast and precise single-tube multicolour flow cytometry assay for the determination of immune status from peripheral blood.
the establishment of a fast, precise and easy-to-use assay for the determination of the immune status of cancer patients.
the development and establishment of a fast and easy to perform flow cytometric assay that allows the analysis of the immune status in peripheral blood of cancer patients.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this assay allows a fast, precise, reliable and easy to perform analysis of immune cell subsets and activation status in peripheral blood.
this assay is a valuable tool for the characterization of the immune status and dynamics of cancer patients and for the assessment of the efficacy of immune modulating therapies.
the here described assay allows the precise determination of the immune status in peripheral whole-blood and therefore is a valuable tool for clinical routine and translational research.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we developed an easy to perform assay for the determination of the individual patient's immune status.
this assay is a fast, easy, precise and cost-effective tool to determine the immune status from a peripheral blood sample.
this assay can provide a detailed overview of the patient's immune status and is therefore a useful tool to improve clinical decision making.
The main takeaway from our work is that
this assay allows the determination of the immune status of patients and the monitoring of immune dynamics in clinical routine.
this single-tube multicolour flow cytometry assay is suitable for clinical routine and can help to improve patient's therapy.
this assay is a powerful tool to monitor the effects of immunotherapies on patients and their immune systems.
